# awscc_glue_table_optimizer (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::Glue::TableOptimizer



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `catalog_id` (String) The catalog ID of the table
- `database_name` (String) The name of the database. For Hive compatibility, this is folded to lowercase when it is stored.
- `table_name` (String) The table name. For Hive compatibility, this must be entirely lowercase.
- `table_optimizer_configuration` (Attributes) Specifies configuration details of a table optimizer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_optimizer_configuration))
- `type` (String) The type of table optimizer.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--table_optimizer_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `table_optimizer_configuration`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the table optimization is enabled.
- `role_arn` (String) A role passed by the caller which gives the service permission to update the resources associated with the optimizer on the caller's behalf.

Optional:

- `compaction_configuration` (Attributes) The configuration for a compaction optimizer. This configuration defines how data files in your table will be compacted to improve query performance and reduce storage costs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_optimizer_configuration--compaction_configuration))
- `orphan_file_deletion_configuration` (Attributes) OrphanFileDeletionConfiguration is a property that can be included within the TableOptimizer resource. It controls the automatic deletion of orphaned files - files that are not tracked by the table metadata, and older than the configured age limit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_optimizer_configuration--orphan_file_deletion_configuration))
- `retention_configuration` (Attributes) The configuration for a snapshot retention optimizer for Apache Iceberg tables. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_optimizer_configuration--retention_configuration))
- `vpc_configuration` (Attributes) An object that describes the VPC configuration for a table optimizer. This configuration is necessary to perform optimization on tables that are in a customer VPC. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_optimizer_configuration--vpc_configuration))

<a id="nestedatt--table_optimizer_configuration--compaction_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `table_optimizer_configuration.compaction_configuration`

Optional:

- `iceberg_configuration` (Attributes) The configuration for an Iceberg compaction optimizer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_optimizer_configuration--compaction_configuration--iceberg_configuration))

<a id="nestedatt--table_optimizer_configuration--compaction_configuration--iceberg_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `table_optimizer_configuration.compaction_configuration.iceberg_configuration`

Optional:

- `delete_file_threshold` (Number) The minimum number of deletes in a data file to make it eligible for compaction.
- `min_input_files` (Number) The minimum number of input files before compaction is triggered.
- `strategy` (String) The compaction strategy to use. Valid values are binpack, sort, and z-order.



<a id="nestedatt--table_optimizer_configuration--orphan_file_deletion_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `table_optimizer_configuration.orphan_file_deletion_configuration`

Optional:

- `iceberg_configuration` (Attributes) The IcebergConfiguration property helps optimize your Iceberg tables in AWS Glue by allowing you to specify format-specific settings that control how data is stored, compressed, and managed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_optimizer_configuration--orphan_file_deletion_configuration--iceberg_configuration))

<a id="nestedatt--table_optimizer_configuration--orphan_file_deletion_configuration--iceberg_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `table_optimizer_configuration.orphan_file_deletion_configuration.iceberg_configuration`

Optional:

- `location` (String) Specifies a directory in which to look for orphan files (defaults to the table's location). You may choose a sub-directory rather than the top-level table location.
- `orphan_file_retention_period_in_days` (Number) The specific number of days you want to keep the orphan files.



<a id="nestedatt--table_optimizer_configuration--retention_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `table_optimizer_configuration.retention_configuration`

Optional:

- `iceberg_configuration` (Attributes) The configuration for an Iceberg snapshot retention optimizer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--table_optimizer_configuration--retention_configuration--iceberg_configuration))

<a id="nestedatt--table_optimizer_configuration--retention_configuration--iceberg_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `table_optimizer_configuration.retention_configuration.iceberg_configuration`

Optional:

- `clean_expired_files` (Boolean)
- `number_of_snapshots_to_retain` (Number)
- `snapshot_retention_period_in_days` (Number)



<a id="nestedatt--table_optimizer_configuration--vpc_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `table_optimizer_configuration.vpc_configuration`

Optional:

- `glue_connection_name` (String) The name of the AWS Glue connection used for the VPC for the table optimizer.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_glue_table_optimizer.example
  identity = {
    table_name    = "table_name"
    database_name = "database_name"
    type          = "type"
    catalog_id    = "catalog_id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `catalog_id` (String) The catalog ID of the table
- `database_name` (String) The name of the database
- `table_name` (String) The table name
- `type` (String) The type of table optimizer

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_glue_table_optimizer.example
  id = "table_name|database_name|type|catalog_id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_glue_table_optimizer.example "table_name|database_name|type|catalog_id"
```
